title: Sponsor your parents and grandparents - Canada.ca
main_content: Sponsor your parents and grandparentsThis is a program to sponsor your parents and grandparents to become permanent residents of Canada.New Ministerial Instructions for the Parents and Grandparents Program come into effect January 1, 2026These administrative steps allow us to keep processing existing applications into 2026. Details on the next intake will be shared on our website andsocial media channelsas soon as they are available.2025 intakeStarting July 28, 2025, we invited potential sponsors who submitted an interest to sponsor form in 2020 to apply for the 2025 intake.We sent 17,860 invitations over approximately 2 weeks. Our goal is to accept 10,000 complete applications.The last day to apply was October 9, 2025.We’re no longer accepting applications.Status2025 intakeClosedBy invitation onlyProcessing timesCheck processing timesFeesStarting fromError loading fee.Check the fee list.If you were not invited to apply to sponsor your parents and grandparentsYour parents and grandpare
